arguments.prose:
Findings: A restart_consumer_group action was issued for worker-dispatcher (kill_key_cleared=true, latency_key_cleared=false); lag climbed from 36 to 61 immediately after the restart before dropping to 0 in the subsequent verify read at 11:13:55Z, though the latency key was not cleared and sustained recovery has not been confirmed beyond that single moment. No remaining causes block was present in this run, so no additional open causes were flagged.

Recommendation: Confirm that worker-dispatcher lag is holding at 0 with a current read, and check whether the uncleared latency key is causing any residual processing delay before closing the incident.
